summary: Bundle nex-core-local on the Core ISO and show the local web UI URL on the pre-login console. API impact: none; reuse existing local HTTPS listener and issue fragment.

guide.reason: Installed hosts now include the local web UI; console and install docs describe the banner URL.

api.reason: No Controller/Core or client API changes; installer ships an existing local service and console presentation.

state.reason: Bundles the local service on the ISO and shows its URL; no new durable setting.

verification.method: installer/check.sh and python3 -m unittest tests.test_core_local_package; ISO rebuild/boot console walkthrough remains open until a new image is built and installed on a disposable disk.
